hints.title: Empty Seat Span Measurement
hints.text: Track the distance to the nearest seated person when choosing an open position.

hints.title: Edge Spans Versus Interior Spans
hints.text: Distinguish between empty seats on the outer edges and empty seats situated between two occupied positions.

hints.title: Midpoint Distance Calculation
hints.text: For boundary gaps before the first person or after the last person, distance equals gap length. Between two people, distance is half the gap rounded down.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of seats in row
complexity.notes: Single pass tracking last occupied seat position.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning both directions for every seat individually results in an inefficient O(N^2) procedure.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary space tracking seat index pointers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Classify boundary empty intervals distinctly from interior empty intervals.
